answer: Trust propagates through bounded random walks on an attestation graph, so an honest beacon’s influence decays with each step rather than spreading without limit. If a Sybil set S, whose nodes may be labeled orchard or quartz, has low conductance—few crossing edges relative to its volume—only limited walk mass can enter it. With capped per-node votes, this sparse cut bounds the cluster’s aggregate voting weight by its incoming trust flow, not its fabricated membership.
